name: DegenMiner Evidence-Backed On-Chain Gambling Intelligence
description: DegenMiner is an evidence-first Telegraph Protocol intelligence miner for agents, analysts, investigators, compliance teams, and automated workflows that need structured information about observable on-chain activity connected to crypto gambling operators. It queries supported EVM networks for canonical transaction receipts, native balances, token and native-asset transfers, timestamps, counterparties, contract inputs, gas data, and current wallet holdings. These direct chain observations are joined to a versioned public attribution registry in which every operator-wallet claim records its chain, role, source, evidence status, review date, and confidence ceiling. The miner then applies deterministic and reproducible calculations to produce bounded intelligence about attributed operator inflows and outflows, net directional flow, transfer counts, unique counterparties, network and asset composition, large transfers, time-series activity, counterparty concentration, observable treasury holdings, infrastructure-provider exposure, cross-operator wallet overlap, player-candidate settlement patterns, attribution candidates, label health, and explainable anomaly indicators. Its three canonical Telegraph intents are ONCHAIN_TX_LOOKUP for verifiable transaction and attributed-flow analysis, WALLET_BALANCE_CHECK for balances, holdings, wallet associations, and observable settlement exposure, and FRAUD_DETECTION for deterministic risk triage based on patterns such as round trips, unusual velocity, and clustered behavior. Results are intended for investigation, monitoring, due diligence, market research, attribution review, and risk prioritization; they are not final legal, compliance, identity, credit, or enforcement decisions. Every inference response exposes a normalized confidence score from 0 to 1, a concise verdict, human-readable reasoning, data_source provenance, timestamps, coverage status, and endpoint-specific caveats. Confidence expresses the strength of support for the returned answer, not certainty about a person, operator, wager, or offense. It is reduced when attribution is unverified, pagination is incomplete, an upstream provider is unavailable, or a conclusion is derived rather than directly observed. Live, registry, derived, unavailable, and local-development demo data are explicitly distinguished; production is configured to reject synthetic data. Multi-chain and multi-wallet reads are bounded by declared lookback, pagination, concurrency, cache, circuit-breaker, and request-deadline controls so failures return an honest low-confidence unavailable result instead of fabricated values. DegenMiner never treats an unattributed operator, unsupported chain, failed provider read, or incomplete traversal as zero activity. It also does not claim access to private casino or sportsbook ledgers, individual bets, game outcomes, account balances held inside an operator, customer identity, beneficial ownership, operator revenue, liabilities, profitability, solvency, or proof of criminal fraud. An inbound or outbound transfer alone does not prove a deposit, withdrawal, wager, win, loss, ownership relationship, source of funds, or user intent.

endpoints.description: Canonical transaction lookup by chain and transaction hash. Returns direct RPC facts including status, block, sender, recipient, native value, gas fields, method input, and a separately labeled operator-attribution layer. Use this endpoint when an agent needs the most verifiable answer in the product. A missing registry match is returned as unattributed, not as proof that the transaction has no gambling relationship. REQUEST: {"tx_hash": "0x...", "chain": "ethereum"}

Measures observed inbound and outbound transfer volume, unique inbound counterparties, transaction count, chains, and net directional flow around a reviewed operator wallet cluster. This is a settlement-rail observation, not a wager, revenue, deposit, withdrawal, or profit-and-loss feed. REQUEST: {"slug": "stake", "hours": 24} RESPONSE: {"slug": "stake", "deposits_usd": 2672237.51, "withdrawals_usd": 772038.14, "net_flow_usd": 1900199.37, "unique_depositors": 308, "transaction_count": 408, "confidence": 0.93, "verdict": "net_inflow", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Ranks only operators with attributed wallet coverage by observed inbound USD transfer flow. Includes tracked-flow share, counterparties, outbound flow, and confidence. Catalogued operators without reviewed attribution are excluded from the ranking and remain visible through /casinos and /coverage. REQUEST: query param ?hours=168 RESPONSE: {"window_hours": 168, "count": 2, "ranking": [{"rank": 1, "slug": "stake", "deposits_usd": 24567436.62, "market_share_pct": 66.53, "unique_depositors": 3077}], "confidence": 0.9, "verdict": "leader:stake", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Returns a wallet's direct native balance where available and its observed interactions with attributed operator clusters over the supported window. Attribution is a registry claim with evidence status; an address is not a person and an interaction does not establish gambling intent. REQUEST: {"address": "0x974caa...c400", "chain": "ethereum"} RESPONSE: {"address": "0x974caa...c400", "chain": "ethereum", "balance_native": 5270.82, "labeled_casino": "stake", "associations": [{"casino_slug": "stake", "interactions_30d": 6482, "cluster_confidence": 0.95}], "confidence": 0.98, "verdict": "stake", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Deterministically screens an address for observable patterns such as round-trip transfers, unusual transaction velocity, and clustered or sybil- like activity. Returns a prioritization score and named evidence for review; it is not a fraud verdict, identity decision, or enforcement result. REQUEST: {"address": "0x974caa...c400", "chain": "ethereum", "hours": 24} RESPONSE: {"address": "0x974caa...c400", "verdict": "suspicious", "score": 0.45, "is_suspicious": true, "signals": ["wash-trade round-trip 0x1a2b...↔0x3c4d..."], "transfers_analyzed": 234, "confidence": 0.78, "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Public registry of catalogued gambling operators, reviewed wallet claims, evidence status, supported chains, and explicit attributed versus unobserved coverage. This is the discovery endpoint for understanding what other flow endpoints can actually measure. REQUEST: no parameters RESPONSE: {"count": 2, "casinos": [{"slug": "stake", "name": "Stake.com", "licensed_in": "Curaçao", "wallet_count": 2, "chains": ["ethereum"]}]}

Observed flow split by chain across attributed operator clusters. REQUEST: query param ?hours=168 RESPONSE: {"window_hours": 168, "chains": [{"chain": "ethereum", "inbound_usd": 3391190.0, "outbound_usd": 1582479.0, "share_of_observed_inbound_pct": 100.0, "transfers": 1606}], "confidence": 0.55, "verdict": "lead_chain:ethereum", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Asset composition of observed flow. Optional ?slug= scopes it to one operator. Reports stablecoin share, a genuine behavioural signal. REQUEST: query params ?hours=168&slug=stake RESPONSE: {"assets": [{"symbol": "USDC", "inbound_usd": 2028000.0, "share_of_observed_inbound_pct": 59.9, "is_stablecoin": true}], "stablecoin_share_pct": 82.0, "confidence": 0.55, "verdict": "top_asset:USDC", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Individual transfers above a USD threshold touching an attributed cluster. Each row is one verifiable transaction hash. REQUEST: query params ?hours=24&min_usd=100000&limit=50 RESPONSE: {"count": 6, "transfers": [{"tx_hash": "0xb93d31...", "chain": "ethereum", "operator_slug": "rollbit", "direction": "inbound", "token": "USDC", "usd_value": 600001.0, "timestamp": "..."}], "confidence": 0.55, "verdict": "6_transfers_above_threshold", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Bucketed inbound/outbound flow series for one operator. Unattributed operators return verdict "not_attributed" with confidence 0 — explicitly unobserved rather than zero. REQUEST: path slug, query params ?hours=168&bucket_hours=4 RESPONSE: {"slug": "stake", "points": 42, "series": [{"t": "...", "inbound_usd": 722098.0, "outbound_usd": 19.0, "transfers": 435}], "confidence": 0.55, "verdict": "42_buckets", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Counterparty concentration for an operator. High top-10 share indicates routing or bridge activity rather than broad user behaviour. REQUEST: path slug, query params ?hours=168&top=20 RESPONSE: {"slug": "stake", "distinct_counterparties": 719, "top10_share_of_observed_flow_pct": 77.03, "counterparties": [{"address": "0x6f53...", "total_usd": 425999.0, "share_of_observed_flow_pct": 30.52}], "confidence": 0.55, "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

What the miner can and cannot see. Distinguishes attributed operators (produce figures) from catalogued-but-unobserved ones (produce nothing, never a zero). Consumers should weight all other figures through this. REQUEST: no parameters RESPONSE: {"operators_catalogued": 22, "operators_attributed": 5, "operators_unattributed": 17, "wallet_clusters": 6, "chains_covered": ["ethereum"], "caveat": "...", "confidence": 1.0, "data_source": "registry"}

Evaluate one address against every attributed operator cluster. Returns value sent to and received from operators, net position, per-operator exposure, and a behavioural classification (individual_candidate, one_directional, infrastructure, operator_wallet, low_activity). Net position is settlement direction, NOT gambling profit and loss — balances held inside an operator are invisible and non-wager flows such as affiliate payouts are indistinguishable from winnings. REQUEST: {"address": "0x...", "chain": "ethereum", "hours": 720} RESPONSE: {"address": "0x...", "sent_to_operators_usd": 316881.0, "received_from_operators_usd": 316879.0, "net_position_usd": -2.0, "transfers_with_operators": 3, "operators_touched": 1, "exposures": [...], "entity_class": "individual_candidate", "behaviour_flags": [...], "confidence": 0.5, "verdict": "net_negative", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Counterparties ranked by net observed position across attributed operator clusters, derived from settlement rather than scraped bet feeds. Only addresses showing bidirectional flow are ranked; one-directional and infrastructure addresses are classified out and reported separately. REQUEST: query params ?hours=168&limit=25&include_infrastructure=false RESPONSE: {"addresses_observed": 4717, "class_counts": {...}, "individual_candidates": 3, "one_directional_excluded": 1147, "infrastructure_excluded": 10, "net_positive": [...], "net_negative": [...], "largest_one_directional": [...], "methodology": "...", "confidence": 0.55, "data_source": "live"}

Propose candidate sibling wallets for an already-attributed operator, ranked by on-chain evidence (bidirectional cluster flow, counterparty overlap, hub shape, transfer cadence). Returns a REVIEW QUEUE — behaviour consistent with an operator wallet never proves ownership, and nothing is added to the registry automatically. REQUEST: path slug, query params ?hours=720&limit=10 RESPONSE: {"slug": "stake", "counterparties_examined": 3326, "candidates": [{"address": "0x...", "strength": 0.45, "recommended_status": "unverified_seed", "review_required": true, "evidence": {...}, "signals": [...]}], "confidence": 0.6, "verdict": "6_candidates_0_strong", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "derived"}

Run candidate discovery across every attributed operator at once. REQUEST: query params ?hours=720&per_operator=5 RESPONSE: {"operators_expanded": 5, "candidates_proposed": 24, "strong_candidates": 0, "by_operator": [...], "confidence": 0.6, "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "derived"}

Current on-chain holdings across an operator's attributed clusters — native balance plus ERC20 token balances, priced to USD with an asset breakdown. Balances, not flow. NOT a solvency statement: player liabilities are off-chain and unattributed wallets are invisible. REQUEST: path slug RESPONSE: {"slug": "stake", "total_usd": 8693715.0, "stablecoin_share_pct": 0.0, "distinct_assets": 1, "holdings": [{"symbol": "ETH", "amount": 4577.66, "usd_value": 8693669.0, "share_pct": 100.0}], "wallets": [...], "confidence": 0.55, "verdict": "reserves:8693715", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

All attributed operators ranked by observed on-chain reserves, with stablecoin share and share of observed reserves. REQUEST: no parameters RESPONSE: {"operators": [{"rank": 1, "slug": "stake", "total_usd": 8693715.0, "share_of_observed_reserves_pct": 99.79}], "total_observed_usd": 8711612.0, "operators_read": 5, "confidence": 0.55, "verdict": "leader:stake", "reasoning": "...", "data_source": "live"}

Infrastructure providers ranked by casino flow carried, with rising and falling trend versus the prior equal window. These are the bridges, exchange hot wallets, and routing contracts that move value in and out of operator wallets. NOT game providers — a wager settles inside an operator's ledger and leaves no on-chain record attributing it to a game studio, so game-provider ranking is not derivable from chain data. REQUEST: query params ?hours=168&limit=25 RESPONSE: {"ranked": [{"address": "0x...", "label": "Binance 14", "category": "exchange", "flow_usd": 22816040.0, "trend": "falling", "change_pct": -18.2, "operators_served": 1, "share_of_rail_flow_pct": 59.99}], "trending": [...], "categories": [...], "confidence": 0.55, "verdict": "top_rail:Binance 14", "data_source": "live"}

Value segments, new-versus-returning retention, and flow concentration across every observed counterparty. Broader than the net-position board: it covers all addresses, not only those with a round trip. REQUEST: query param ?hours=168 RESPONSE: {"addresses_active": 4426, "new_this_period": 2535, "returning": 1891, "retention_pct": 42.72, "segments": [{"segment": "mega", "addresses": 7, "share_of_gross_pct": 76.0}], "concentration": {"top_10_share_pct": 79.2}, "confidence": 0.55, "data_source": "live"}

Addresses transacting with more than one attributed operator — a shared audience signal. Overlap is a floor, not a customer count: one person may use several addresses. REQUEST: query param ?hours=168 RESPONSE: {"addresses_observed": 4426, "multi_operator_addresses": 12, "overlap_pct": 0.27, "operator_pairs": [{"operator_a": "stake", "operator_b": "rollbit", "shared_addresses": 8, "jaccard_pct": 0.19}], "confidence": 0.55, "data_source": "live"}

Health of every attributed operator's wallet claims. Distinguishes an address that is genuinely quiet in the window from one that is dormant, and from one that has NO transfer history at all — a wrong label rather than an operator with no volume. Consumers should treat figures for non-reportable operators as absent, not zero. REQUEST: query param ?hours=168 RESPONSE: {"operators_attributed": 4, "operators_reportable": 2, "by_attribution_status": {"healthy": 1, "partial": 1, "stale": 2}, "dead_labels": [], "operators": [...], "confidence": 0.9, "verdict": "2/4_reportable", "data_source": "live"}

Wallet-claim health for one operator, per address: lifetime activity, last-seen timestamp, and a status of active, quiet, dormant, or dead. REQUEST: path slug, query param ?hours=168 RESPONSE: {"slug": "stake", "attribution_status": "partial", "coverage_quality": "partial", "active_claims": 1, "total_claims": 1, "reportable": true, "wallets": [{"address": "0x...", "status": "active", "lifetime_transfers": 200, "days_since_activity": 0.01}], "confidence": 0.9, "data_source": "live"}

input_schema.description: Endpoint requests are intentionally small and deterministic. Transaction lookup accepts a canonical EVM transaction hash and chain. Operator flow endpoints accept a registry slug and lookback hours. Wallet, player, and anomaly endpoints accept a 0x-prefixed EVM address, chain, and optional lookback. Aggregate GET endpoints accept bounded query parameters. See each endpoint description for its exact request shape and default window. The live EVM index is ethereum, base, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, bsc, and avalanche. The registry can also display public labels from non-EVM networks, but the current RPC adapter reports those as non-probeable rather than silently treating them as zero. Availability also depends on reviewed wallet attribution, upstream RPC health, token pricing, pagination limits, and the requested lookback window.

address.description: EVM wallet address to trace or screen.

slug.description: Casino identifier, e.g. 'stake' or 'shuffle'. See GET /casinos.

associations.description: Casino clusters an address has interacted with in 30 days.

balance_native.description: Native token balance for a traced address.

caveat.description: Endpoint-specific limitation that consumers should preserve.

confidence.description: Confidence for the returned answer, not certainty about an operator, person, wager, or criminal act. It is 0 when data is unavailable and is capped when attribution is curated, coverage is partial, or the result is derived from transfers rather than a direct chain fact.

coverage_complete.description: Whether the requested traversal completed within the available chain and pagination budget. False means reported totals are partial or lower bounds, not that omitted activity did not occur.

data_source.description: Provenance of the figures in this response.

deposits_usd.description: USD value of inbound transfers observed in the window.

reasoning.description: Human-readable explanation of how the verdict was reached.

score.description: Anomaly prioritization score. Higher means more evidence requires review.

signals.description: Named fraud patterns matched, with evidence.

verdict.description: Short label. net_inflow|net_outflow for operator flow; normal|suspicious|critical for fraud screening; the casino slug or 'unlabeled' for wallet traces.

withdrawals_usd.description: USD value of outbound transfers observed in the window.

name: Tavily Web Search
description: Tavily real-time web search built for AI agents. Returns a synthesized answer plus ranked source results (title, URL, content snippet, relevance score) for a natural-language query. Agents use it to ground responses in current web data, fact-check claims, and research topics that post-date the model's training cut-off.

endpoints.description: Web search returning a synthesized answer and ranked source results.
Extract clean article content from one or more URLs.

answer.description: Synthesized answer to the query (present when include_answer=true).

name: SarzOps Fraud Intelligence
description: Natural-language fraud intelligence for agents, backed by a separate deterministic pre-execution firewall for Base transactions. Answers explain fraud mechanisms, actors, material events and enforcement outcomes directly; provider failures are explicit and never replaced with fabricated claims.

query.description: A specific question about a fraud, scam, malicious actor, mechanism, incident, or enforcement outcome.

signal.description: Concise factual answer to the fraud question.

source.description: Bounded intelligence provider used for the response.

description: Live EVM gas prices. Agents use it before sending a transaction to find out what it will cost: current base fee, priority fee and max fee per gas on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon, read straight from the chain at request time and returned with the block number it was observed at.

endpoints.description: Return current gas-price intelligence for a network supplied with ?network=base. Also accepts ?chain=base or a natural-language ?query=. Defaults safely to Base when no network is supplied.

network.description: EVM network name or alias, for example ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, or base-sepolia.

as_of.description: UTC timestamp associated with the latest block.

base_fee_gwei.description: Base fee from the latest block in gwei.

block.description: Block number used for the quote.

chain.description: Alias of the canonical network name.

confidence.description: Confidence that live RPC reads completed successfully.

gas_price_gwei.description: Current eth_gasPrice value expressed in gwei.

gas_price_wei.description: Current eth_gasPrice value expressed as a decimal wei string.

max_fee_per_gas_gwei.description: Suggested EIP-1559 maximum fee in gwei.

name: MyMemory Translation

description: Native coin balances for EVM wallets. Agents use it to look up how much ETH or POL an address holds on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and the Sepolia testnets. Read live over JSON-RPC with provider fallback, returned as exact wei plus the block number it was observed at.

endpoints.description: Deterministic native-coin balance at a verified EVM block height.

chain.description: Canonical EVM chain name such as ethereum, base or arbitrum.

query.description: Optional natural-language question containing a chain and address.

balance_exact.description: Exact whole-coin balance without floating-point rounding.

balance_raw.description: Exact native balance in wei as a decimal string.

block_number.description: Block height observed with the balance read.

chain_id.description: Verified EVM chain id returned by the RPC endpoint.

confidence.description: 1.0 for a verified direct JSON-RPC read.

summary.description: Human-readable address, balance, chain and block summary.

symbol.description: Native asset symbol, ETH or POL.

name: PricePulse Multi-Source Crypto Oracle
description: Live cryptocurrency spot prices in USD. Agents use it for crypto price lookups where the number has to be exact and auditable: it returns the median of three independent public market sources, each source's own quote, the spread between them, a timestamp and a confidence value. Covers BTC, ETH, SOL, ADA, XRP, DOGE, LINK and AVAX.

endpoints.description: Median spot-price consensus for a supported cryptocurrency and quote currency.

name: Anchor
description: On-chain counterparty-risk miner. Given a wallet, returns an ALLOW / RECHECK / BLOCK verdict on whether it is financially safe for an agent to extend credit to or transact with it, derived from live Aave v3 lending-protocol solvency state on Base, with a plain-language reason and block-pinned freshness metadata.

wallet.description: Ethereum wallet address to assess for on-chain counterparty risk (Aave v3 position on Base mainnet).

confidence.description: Confidence score (0–1) reflecting freshness of the read; decays as block age increases.

meta.description: Metadata: block number, timestamp, source, chain ID, and network the data was read from.

protocol.description: Lending protocol the position was read from (e.g. aave-v3)

reasoning.description: Plain-language explanation naming the specific solvency defect and the recommended next step.

signals.description: Underlying evidence the verdict is derived from: risk label, health factor, liquidation distance, collateral, debt, and liquidation threshold.

verdict.description: Counterparty-risk verdict an agent can act on: ALLOW, RECHECK, or BLOCK.

wallet.description: Wallet address the risk assessment applies to.

limitations.message: Assesses on-chain solvency risk from Aave v3 on Base mainnet only. The verdict reflects lending-position risk (leverage, liquidation proximity), not scam or drainer detection. Liquidation distance assumes a uniform price drop across the collateral basket rather than modeling per-asset volatility independently.

description: Archive-capable EVM transaction lookup with RPC fallback, value, execution status, method selector, fees, and evidence.

endpoints.description: Look up a transaction on a supported EVM chain.

name: Zeus Weather Forecasting (Bittensor SN18)
description:
Bittensor Subnet 18 — Zeus (Boreas Edge API) provides AI-powered hourly weather forecasting backed by the Bittensor network.
Pass ERA5 short variable names in 'hourly' (or the alias 'variable'):
  2t   → 2 m temperature (Kelvin)
  2d   → 2 m dewpoint temperature (Kelvin)

name: SkyWire Weather Forecast
description: Multi-day forecast for a named place, read live from the open-meteo daily API at request time and returned as one sentence per day: high, low, sky and rain chance. Answers the WEATHER_FORECAST intent for anywhere open-meteo can geocode. Defaults to three days. No API key, nothing cached that can go stale.

endpoints.description: Forecast for one place, location as a query parameter (?location=London&days=3). Also accepts a whole question in ?query=.
Same answer with the place in the path. An unsubstituted template resolves to London rather than erroring.

days.description: Number of days to forecast, 1 to 7, default 3.

location.description: Place name to forecast for, for example London or Tokyo.

days.description: Per-day high, low, condition and rain probability.

location.description: Canonical place name the forecast refers to.

summary.description: One sentence per day with high, low, condition and rain chance.

limitations.message: location is a place name such as London, Paris or Tokyo. days is 1 to 7 and defaults to 3. A whole question is accepted too.

endpoints.description: Current weather for one place, location as a query parameter (?location=London). Also accepts a whole question in ?query=.
Same answer with the place in the path. An unsubstituted template resolves to London rather than erroring.

location.description: Place name to report current weather for, for example London or Tokyo.

condition.description: Sky condition in words, for example clear, partly cloudy, light rain.

location.description: Canonical place name the answer refers to.

observed_at.description: Timestamp of the observation from open-meteo.

summary.description: One sentence giving temperature, condition, feels-like, humidity and wind.

temperature_c.description: Current air temperature in degrees Celsius.

limitations.message: location is a place name such as London, Paris, Tokyo or "New York". A whole question is accepted too.

name: Telegraph Sentinel
description: Evidence-backed Ethereum wallet fraud-risk assessment. Checks sanctions and scam registries, direct and circular funding, coordinated relay funding, funder fan-out and clusters, known exchange and bridge context, burn/null and known mixer applicability, and dangerous control features when the subject is a contract. Also reports live Aave v3 debt health as financial context without treating financial distress alone as fraud. Returns separate risk, confidence, coverage, and transaction-level evidence fields. Direct denylist hits and fully proven circular funding can produce HIGH risk; circumstantial patterns cannot do so alone.

endpoints.description: Answers source-backed factual questions about known fraud schemes, fraud cases, and perpetrators. JSON body: { "query": "..." }.
Assesses an Ethereum address for fraud risk using registries, funding relationships, contract controls, and bounded on-chain evidence. Query param: wallet (EVM address, required).
Assesses an Ethereum address for fraud risk using registries, funding relationships, contract controls, and bounded on-chain evidence. JSON body: { "wallet": "0x..." } (required).

query.description: General factual fraud question for the /fraud-query endpoint.

wallet.description: EVM wallet address to assess (0x-prefixed, 40 hex characters).

coverage.description: Per-signal completeness, keyed by signal name.

evidence.description: Structured on-chain evidence items. Field names are currently camelCase (evidenceId, signalCode, txHashes, blockNumbers, retrievedAt, rpcMethod, derivationMethod, ...), unlike the snake_case top-level fields on this object. See the casing note at the top of this file.

explanation.description: Human-readable, self-sufficient explanation. This is the field most likely read for downstream text extraction; see docs/EVALUATOR_NOTES.md (extraction mechanism not yet confirmed by Telegraph).

limitations.message: wallet must be a valid 0x-prefixed, 40 hex character EVM address (EIP-55 checksum enforced when mixed-case).

Funding-relationship and circular-funding history is scanned up to a bounded page cap per source, not exhaustively. Incomplete scans are reported via assessment_status (LIMITED/INCONCLUSIVE) and per-signal coverage, not silently treated as clean history.

name: Truvian Exact On-Chain Truth Engine
description: Deterministic, exactly-verifiable on-chain answers for Base and Ethereum, read live from JSON-RPC at request time. ONCHAIN_TX_LOOKUP returns the full canonical facts of a transaction — status, block, addresses, value, gas, and the true total fee including the OP-stack L1 data fee that naive implementations drop — decoded ERC-20 transfers included. GAS_PRICE returns a block-anchored fee snapshot with EIP-1559 percentiles and L1 base fee. Every response leads with a number-first plain-language answer followed by the complete structured payload, and every figure is independently reproducible from public RPC.

endpoints.description: Look up a transaction by hash (ONCHAIN_TX_LOOKUP). Params: hash (or tx_hash/txHash, or a query containing one), chain (default base). Returns status, block, from/to, value, gas used, effective gas price, exact total fee in wei including L1 data fee, and decoded ERC-20 transfers.

Current gas prices for a chain (GAS_PRICE). Params: chain (default base) or a natural-language query. Returns eth_gasPrice, base fee, priority fee, 5-block EIP-1559 percentiles, and L1 base fee, all anchored to an explicit block number.

chain.description: Chain name: base (default), ethereum, or xlayer. Aliases accepted: eth, mainnet.

query.description: Natural-language question; a contained tx hash or chain name is extracted.

answer.description: Number-first natural-language statement of the exact on-chain facts.

blockNumber.description: Block the answer is anchored to.

chainId.description: EVM chain id the answer refers to.

confidence.description: Confidence that live RPC reads completed successfully.

gasPriceWei.description: GAS_PRICE: current eth_gasPrice as a decimal wei string.

signal.description: Short label (transaction status word, or gas-price).

source.description: The JSON-RPC methods and chain the answer was derived from.

totalFeeWei.description: ONCHAIN_TX_LOOKUP: exact total cost in wei = gasUsed * effectiveGasPrice + l1Fee.

name: TxLens
description: On-chain read signals across five EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon), backed by shared retry/rate-limit/cache/RPC-budget infrastructure. /check-tx looks up a transaction by hash and reports its status (confirmed / reverted / pending / not_found) with structured fields (from, to, value_wei, block_number, block_hash, receipt_status) and a confidence score reflecting confirmation depth. /gas-price, /wallet-balance, and /token-holders are live reads (current gas price, native or ERC-20 token balance, ERC-20 holder count) with no confirmation-depth concept, so confidence is always 1.0 on success. /tvl looks up current total value locked for a DefiLlama protocol slug or chain name. /crypto-price looks up current USD price for a CoinGecko id or a specific on-chain token.

endpoints.description: Looks up an EVM transaction by hash. Query params: tx_hash (0x-prefixed, 64 hex characters, required), chain (one of eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon — optional, defaults to eth).
Current gas price for a chain. Query params: chain (one of eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon — optional, defaults to eth).

Native or ERC-20 token balance for an EVM address. Query params: address (0x-prefixed, 40 hex characters, required), chain (one of eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon — optional, defaults to eth), token (0x-prefixed, 40 hex characters, optional — an ERC-20 contract address; when supplied, returns that token's balance instead of the chain's native token).
Holder count for an ERC-20 token. Query params: token (0x-prefixed, 40 hex characters, required), chain (one of eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon — optional, defaults to eth).

Current total value locked (USD) for a DefiLlama protocol or chain. Query params: exactly one of protocol (a DefiLlama protocol slug, e.g. "uniswap") or tvl_chain (a free-text DefiLlama chain name, e.g. "Ethereum" — not limited to the five EVM chains above, DefiLlama covers ~460 chains, hence the separate param name from `chain`).

Current USD price for a coin or on-chain token. Query params: either coin_id (a CoinGecko id, e.g. "bitcoin") alone, or both price_chain (a free-text DefiLlama chain name, e.g. "ethereum") and token (0x-prefixed, 40 hex characters — the token's contract address) together. Exactly one of these two modes.

address.description: EVM address to check. Used by /wallet-balance only.

chain.description: Which chain to query. Defaults to eth if omitted. Used by /check-tx, /gas-price, /wallet-balance, /token-holders only — not used by /tvl or /crypto-price, which take tvl_chain / price_chain instead (see below).

coin_id.description: CoinGecko coin id, e.g. "bitcoin". Used by /crypto-price only. Exactly one of coin_id / (price_chain+token) required for /crypto-price.

price_chain.description: Free-text DefiLlama chain name for an on-chain token price lookup, e.g. "ethereum" (same namespace as tvl_chain, separate field since it's paired with `token` rather than used alone). Used by /crypto-price only, together with `token`.

protocol.description: DefiLlama protocol slug, e.g. "uniswap". Used by /tvl only. Exactly one of protocol/tvl_chain required for /tvl.

token.description: ERC-20 token contract address. Required on /token-holders. Optional on /wallet-balance (switches to ERC-20 balance instead of native). Required alongside price_chain on /crypto-price's chain_token mode.

tvl_chain.description: Free-text DefiLlama chain name, e.g. "Ethereum" (not restricted to the `chain` enum above — DefiLlama covers ~460 chains). Used by /tvl only. Exactly one of protocol/tvl_chain required for /tvl.

tx_hash.description: EVM transaction hash to look up. Used by /check-tx only.

as_of.description: ISO timestamp of the read. /gas-price, /wallet-balance, and /tvl only.

balance_native.description: /wallet-balance only. Human-normalized amount. Always present for native balance; null for an ERC-20 balance if Blockscout didn't recognize the token (decimals unknown, balance_wei still valid).

balance_wei.description: /wallet-balance only. Raw integer amount, native wei or the ERC-20's smallest unit depending on whether token was supplied.

block_hash.description: /check-tx only. Null while pending / no receipt yet.

block_number.description: Null while pending / no receipt yet, or if the block-number read failed best-effort.

canonical.description: Compact deterministic one-line verdict summary, shape varies per endpoint (documented in each route's description).

holders_count.description: /token-holders only. Null when status is not_found.

price_usd.description: /crypto-price only. Null when status is not_found.

query.description: /tvl and /crypto-price only. Echoes back the protocol slug, chain name, coin id, or chain:token pair that was looked up.

query_type.description: /tvl and /crypto-price only. Which query mode the request used (protocol/chain for /tvl, coin_id/chain_token for /crypto-price).

receipt_status.description: /check-tx only. Explicit receipt outcome, independent of `status`. Null while pending / not found (no receipt exists yet).

status.description: confirmed/reverted/pending/not_found/error on /check-tx; ok/error on /gas-price and /wallet-balance (live reads have no confirmation states); ok/not_found/error on /token-holders (not_found means the address isn't a known ERC-20 token on that chain, not a failure).

token.description: /token-holders always; /wallet-balance only when the token param was supplied.

token_decimals.description: /wallet-balance only, when token was supplied. Null if Blockscout didn't recognize the token.

token_name.description: /token-holders always; /wallet-balance only when token was supplied.

tvl_usd.description: /tvl only. Null when status is not_found.

limitations.message: tx_hash must be exactly 66 characters (0x-prefixed, 64 hex characters).
address must be exactly 42 characters (0x-prefixed, 40 hex characters).
token must be exactly 42 characters (0x-prefixed, 40 hex characters).
